data.description: New Launch: Binghatti Aquarise in Business Bay
data.long_description:
Welcome to Binghatti Aquarise, a bold new addition to the Dubai skyline, bringing a unique blend of modern waterfront luxury and architectural artistry to Business Bay. Developed by Binghatti, this iconic tower features an exclusive selection of studios to 4-bedroom apartments, including signature suites with private pools, offering residents a lifestyle that’s both vibrant and tranquil.

Inspired by the calm elegance of coastal living, the tower’s shimmering exterior and fluid design reflect a vision of sophistication and serenity. Inside, every space is thoughtfully crafted with high-end finishes, open layouts, and panoramic views of water and cityscapes.

Highlights:

Studio to 4-bedroom apartments + private pool suites
Coastal-inspired design with a striking glass façade
Premium lifestyle amenities and leisure facilities
Breathtaking views of the canal and Downtown skyline
Contemporary interiors with luxury detailing

Location Advantages:
Ideally located in Business Bay, just moments fr om Sheikh Zayed Road, Downtown Dubai, and Dubai International Airport, Aquarise offers unbeatable connectivity and convenience for both homeowners and investors.

Binghatti Aquarise is more than a residence—it’s a destination wh ere luxury, location, and lifestyle come together.
